messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — IP due diligence report
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We've finalised our IP due diligence report on the HX-7 portfolio (circulated separately). Headlines: the granted composition and process patents are in good order; the CEI additive is still a pending EP application so should be taken primarily as licensed know-how; and China must be carved out of the territory given the existing Yangtze licence. Full points and recommendations are in section 5.

We've reflected the territory carve-out in the draft Licence.

Best,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
